title: JR米坂線 羽前小松駅 新ネコ駅長「ビター」就任 川西町で記念セレモニー 先代は去年退任

segments.description: Close-up shot of a black cat wearing a stationmaster's hat and ribbon collar during an inauguration ceremony.
Wide establishing shot of the exterior of Uzen-Komatsu Station on a bright day.
Medium shot of the black cat lounging on a soft blanket with toys inside the station office.
Close-up footage and photographs showing the young black cat when it was rescued earlier in May.
Close-up shot of the official certificate of appointment naming the new cat stationmaster.
Medium shot of staff members presenting the appointment certificate to the cat and adjusting its hat.
Medium shot of visitors taking photos of the cat stationmaster through the station ticket window.
Medium shots of visitors and children being interviewed outside and expressing their affection for the new cat stationmaster.
Medium shot of the cat resting and interacting with visitors while text outlines station rules and future promotional activities.
